name: b.i.t. Bremerhaven IT-Haven
notes: Municipal IT provider states it operates data centers/IT-Haven for municipal and private-sector customers; no power capacity disclosed. Re-verified against methodology (Bremen row: city/state planning pages + UVP-Verbund).

name: Datacon Bremerhaven Rechenzentrum
notes: Datacon's official page offers hosted virtual server environments in its Bremerhaven data center; no capacity disclosed.

name: Alfred Wegener Institute AWI Rechen- und Datenzentrum
developer: Alfred-Wegener-Institut Helmholtz-Zentrum fuer Polar- und Meeresforschung
notes: AWI's Bremerhaven computing/data center supports scientific computing and information systems; no power capacity disclosed.

name: Portus Data Centers IPHH4 Hamburg
notes: New IPHH4 at Internet Port Hamburg Wendenstrasse campus; phase 1 construction Q1 2025 to Q4 2026, total IT load 12.8 MW.

name: Penta Infra HAM01 Hamburg
notes: Penta Infra launched HAM01 with 4.4 MW across 2,500 sqm white space after late-2023 groundbreaking.

name: Equinix HH1 Hamburg IBX
notes: Equinix lists HH1 at Vierenkamp 1, Hamburg; capacity listed by area rather than MW.

name: AKQUINET Rechenzentrum Victoriapark Hamburg-Rahlstedt
notes: High-performance data center in Rahlstedter Gewerbegebiet Victoriapark opened May 2025; built by Green Datahub Holding with AKQUINET for ~70-80 M EUR; 700+ server racks on 2,350 sqm; PV roof, waste-heat reuse for neighbouring buildings. AKQUINET also operates DCs in Alsterdorf (Hamburg), Norderstedt and Itzehoe.

name: nLighten HAM1 Hamburg edge data center
notes: nLighten edge data center in Hamburg (HAM1): 555 sqm dedicated colocation floor, 35 kW.

name: Atlas Edge Datacenter Hamburg Nord (Obenhauptstrasse)
notes: Directory listing for colocation/server-housing facility at Obenhauptstrasse 1c, Hamburg (ISO 9001); no capacity disclosed; C-grade directory lead pending operator confirmation.

name: University of Hamburg Regional Computing Center renovation
notes: University announced renovation/repair of its Regional Computing Center after structural damage; institutional HPC/IT data center.

name: BADEN CLOUD Rechenzentrum Heppenheim
notes: Provider advertises high-availability cloud/data center in Heppenheim, Landkreis Bergstrasse; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: GSI/FAIR Green IT Cube
notes: Scientific HPC data center on GSI/FAIR campus, Darmstadt; GSI states 8 MW cooling capacity in expansion stages 1-2 rising to 12 MW final phase.

name: DARZ Darmstadt Data Center
notes: DARZ lists Darmstadt data center with 8,000 sqm total floor space and 2,400 sqm IT space for up to 1,000 racks; no MW disclosed.

name: STACK Infrastructure Babenhausen hyperscale campus (cancelled)
notes: Planned EUR 3bn hyperscale project near Babenhausen was cancelled/withdrawn amid planning uncertainty and local-government support issues; preserved as negative evidence. Method-driven check of Landkreis Darmstadt-Dieburg found no other commercial DC project.

name: Digital Realty FRA18 Frankfurt (Digital Park Fechenheim)
notes: FRA18 at Hanauer Landstrasse 360 opened with 8,200 sqm colocation space and 16 MW total IT capacity.

name: Digital Realty FRA20 Frankfurt (Digital Park Fechenheim)
notes: Construction started Nov 2025 on FRA20 at Digital Park Fechenheim; ~16 MW IT capacity in two phases, >8,100 sqm white space. Digital Park Fechenheim (former Neckermann site) is being developed as a long-term multi-phase campus of up to eleven data center buildings.

name: CyrusOne FRA7 Frankfurt Westside (Griesheim)
notes: FRA7 at Frankfurt Westside in Griesheim planned for 81 MW IT capacity across two buildings/nine data halls; first 9 MW phase targeted Q2 2026; major waste-heat utilization project.

name: Colt DCS Frankfurt West (Sossenheim)
notes: Colt DCS lists Frankfurt West hyperscale data center in Sossenheim with 25 MW IT load and 10,000 sqm technical area.

name: Iron Mountain FRA-1 and FRA-2 Frankfurt
notes: Iron Mountain lists FRA-1 as 27 MW greenfield Frankfurt facility and FRA-2 as 10.6 MW (37.6 MW total Frankfurt capacity).

name: NTT Frankfurt 1 (ex-e-shelter campus)
notes: Frankfurt 1 is NTT's main Frankfurt campus (60,000+ sqm data center and technical space, Europe's largest single site); official data sheet states 52,200+ sqm IT space and 77.4 MW max IT load. Capacity per methodology operator page (A-).

name: Telehouse Frankfurt (Kleyerstrasse 75-87)
notes: Telehouse Frankfurt carrier-neutral campus 1.8 miles from central Frankfurt, Tier 3, ~25,000 sqm fitted colocation space; connected to DE-CIX. No public MW capacity figure.

name: NETHINKS Housing ITZ Fulda
notes: Aggregator listing identifies NETHINKS Fulda at Am Alten Schlachthof 4 as colocation data center; no MW disclosed; C-grade lead pending operator confirmation.

name: Stadt Fulda municipal Rechenzentrum
notes: City of Fulda states its ZendTo service data is stored on devices operated in the city administration's own data center; no capacity disclosed.

name: Hochschule Fulda Data Center
notes: Fulda University of Applied Sciences lists its Data Center as a central university administration/IT unit; no MW disclosed.

name: Gießen Katzenfeld data center (65 MW connection)
developer: City of Giessen / undisclosed project proponent
notes: Revised Bebauungsplan in Giessen Weststadt/Katzenfeld re-opened for public display; reports cite 65 MW connected load, up to 900 jobs, waste-heat use.

name: Data Center Group / Sommerlad Wettenberg data center
developer: Data Center Group GmbH and Sommerlad
notes: Wettenberg (Landkreis Giessen): proposed ~30,000 sqm site next to Sommerlad central warehouse with data center, office building, battery storage and PV; MW not disclosed in initial reports.

name: Justus Liebig University Giessen Hochschulrechenzentrum
notes: University source documents the Hochschulrechenzentrum/central computing center; institutional facility; no MW disclosed.

name: Vantage Frankfurt II (FRA2) Raunheim campus
notes: Vantage lists Frankfurt II campus in Raunheim (Landkreis Gross-Gerau) with 56 MW critical IT load fully developed; 2022 announcement said first 40 MW facility opened.

name: NTT Frankfurt 3 Ruesselsheim
notes: NTT lists Frankfurt 3 in Ruesselsheim with 28,300+ sqm server space and 60.5 MW IT load.

name: Vantage Gross-Gerau FRA5 / Lausboehl campus proposal (rejected)
notes: Gross-Gerau city council voted against contract negotiations for Vantage's proposed 174 MW campus (~EUR 2.5bn, Lausboehl industrial park area); preserved as negative evidence.

name: AZV Hersfeld-Rotenburg modular IT-Safe data center
notes: Prior1 describes delivering a fully operational modular IT-Safe data center/technology room for AZV Hersfeld-Rotenburg in Bad Hersfeld; no MW disclosed.

name: Oberursel Zimmersmuehlenweg data center
notes: IHK Frankfurt policy brief says Oberursel am Taunus has a data center in the Zimmersmuehlenweg business area; local press references an IBM data center near Gablonzer Strasse/Zimmersmuehlenweg. Operator and capacity not publicly confirmed.

name: DRV Hessen Koenigstein data center and office conversion
notes: Public procurement notices list planning services for 'Rechenzentrum und Umbau Dienststelle DRV Koenigstein' at Altenhainer Str. 1, Koenigstein im Taunus (NUTS DE718 Hochtaunuskreis); institutional data center; capacity not stated.

name: ekom21 Kassel municipal data center
notes: HNA reports ekom21's statewide data center on Knorrstrasse, Kassel; ekom21 site confirms Kassel as one of its offices. Municipal/government IT data center; capacity not disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum Schulte GmbH / Ricoh Asslar operations
notes: Ricoh announced continuation of Rechenzentrum Schulte GmbH operations headquartered in Asslar; Creditreform classifies the company as operating data processing facilities for third parties; capacity not disclosed.

name: OVHcloud LIM1-3 Limburg/Offheim data center
notes: City of Limburg announced OVHcloud building a new data center in the ICE area; local reporting describes OVHcloud's existing Offheim/Limburg data center with ~10,000 servers; map data identifies OVHcloud LIM1-3 at Limburger Strasse 45. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Frank Cube Birstein data center campus
notes: Argaman Group's Frank Cube on 11 ha in Birstein with 200 MW IT load; citizen referendum stopped, project retained municipal-path approval; commissioning shifted from 2028 toward 2029/2030.

name: Google Hanau data center and expansion
notes: Google opened its first Hanau data center in 2023 and announced further Hanau expansion within its EUR 5.5bn Germany cloud/AI program (Nov 2025). Hanau separated from Main-Kinzig-Kreis in 2026; recorded here because the batch division covers the historic Hanau/Main-Kinzig cluster.

name: DATA4 Frankfurt-Hanau campus (Grossauheim)
notes: DATA4 official Frankfurt-Hanau campus: 25 ha land reserves, 180 MW available electricity reserves; Hanau/Grossauheim-Kaserne site expected to reach 180 MW at final build-out; groundbreaking September 2025.

name: CyrusOne Frankfurt V / FRA5 Hanau
notes: CyrusOne broke ground on its newest German data center in Hanau after permit (Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt Genehmigungsbescheid 2024-03-11); tied to a major waste-heat utilization scheme; IT capacity not disclosed in public sources.

name: maincubes FRA03 Schwalbach am Taunus
notes: Four-storey data center on Kronberger Hang, Schwalbach am Taunus; topping-out late 2025; trade coverage identifies FRA03 as 16 MW.

name: Hofheim Marxheim data center
developer: Suedwag Energie / Data Center Group / PRIME Data Centers partnership
notes: Bebauungsplan Nr. 150 and Regionalverband materials create the planning basis for 'Rechenzentrum Marxheim'; Data Center Group magazine describes partnership with Suedwag Energie and PRIME Data Centers; capacity not stated in public planning materials.

name: NTT Frankfurt 4 Hattersheim campus
notes: NTT launched first phase of Frankfurt 4 in Hattersheim (2019, first building 9.7 MW IT load); campus will cover ~24,000 sqm with up to 80 MW power across five data center buildings at full build-out; Mainova district-heating partnership. Method-driven addition to Main-Taunus portfolio.

name: Digital Realty Hattersheim Kastengrund data center site (FRA33)
notes: Digital Realty/Interxion acquired former Sanofi/Kastengrund site in Hattersheim to develop a large data center and substation; DCD reports shell/core construction of FRA33 (Hattersheim) completed June 2023; capacity not disclosed.

name: Philipps-Universitaet Marburg Hochschulrechenzentrum / MaRC3 HPC
notes: University computing center (since 1963); official HPC page lists MaRC3 cluster with data-center GPUs and multi-PB storage; institutional facility, no MW disclosed.

name: Google Dietzenbach data center
notes: Google announced a new Dietzenbach data center near Frankfurt within its EUR 5.5bn Germany investment plan (Nov 2025), with heat-recovery cooperation via Energieversorgung Offenbach. Dietzenbach is in Landkreis Offenbach.

name: maincubes FRA04 Dietzenbach hyperscale data center
notes: maincubes official FRA04 page places the project in Dietzenbach: up to 40 MW IT capacity depending on design, 10,000-12,500 sqm whitespace, 60 MW secured power, expected Q1 2029 readiness.

name: EdgeConneX EDCFRA01 Dietzenbach
notes: DCD reports EdgeConneX developing EDCFRA01 on ~3.6 ha in Dietzenbach (Waldstrasse 43-45); DCAtlas lists 9.1 MW under construction (B/C-level, industry database not developer).
